title: AI Is Finding Security Flaws Faster Than Ever. Are We Ready for What Comes Next?
seoTitleSuggestion: PHP2Shell, AI and the Gap Between Finding and Fixing Flaws | Kryzect
subtitle: How PHP2Shell exposed the awkward distance between discovering a serious vulnerability and making the software behind it safe.
description: PHP2Shell showed how AI-assisted vulnerability research can outrun the work of fixing and deploying software. A closer look at what happened and why it matters.
author: Kryzect
